name: gpa-floor
description: Cumulative GPA below 3.0: the §2.2 floor is unmet and the defense rows carry the 'may not defend' gate note. Since 2026-10-03 (P1-gpa-8) the coursework comes before the EXAM (§4.5), the 3.0 before ADMISSION to candidacy (§2.2) — and since 2026-10-04 (DGS: “OCE and doctoral candidacy are two different things”) the 3.0 is on the admission row, not the OCE row. Since 2026-10-04 (DGS: the OCE can be scheduled at the earliest in the semester the qualifier is expected to be complete) the OCE and admission read Not started here.
